item.title: Rallying Cry – June 17, 2026
item.description: From a Briton’s epic 25-year walk nearing its finish to Messi’s historic sixth World Cup win and Ghana’s push for reparatory justice, today’s good news spans global milestones, sports triumphs, and community progress—plus 6,952 new BTO flats in Singapore and a $100 million boost for affordable housing in Queensland!
